sources.quote: For details on the pricing, please refer to the pricing table above, or on [xAI Console](https://web.archive.org/web/20250911090812/https://console.x.ai/).
sources.supports: xAI's archived documentation points to a pricing table or console, but the extracted page does not provide the rates needed to determine whether the earlier models.dev price was official.

notes: I could not determine whether this was a provider price change or a models.dev correction, or establish an effective date. Wayback CDX listed x.ai/api captures from 2025-06-11 and 2025-09-16, but extraction failed (connection refusal/429); the accessible September documentation does not include its referenced pricing table.
